durability_classes.acknowledgement: the engine's acknowledged recovery state has reached its named non-full-sync operating-system persistence boundary
durability_classes.comparison_rule: process-crash durability only; compare throughput only with other durable rows

protocol.engine_order: deterministic Latin rotation by workload and repetition
protocol.setup_boundary: dataset preparation and prerequisite settlement are excluded from measured workload time
protocol.acknowledgement_boundary: all measured operations returned successfully; mutation acknowledgement uses the row's named durability class
protocol.settled_boundary: acknowledgement followed by synchronous forced flush and two manual compaction drains for mutation workloads
protocol.recovery_boundary: time to reopen after a subprocess acknowledged a marker and exited without running database destructors; post-open marker verification is excluded
protocol.production_scale_rule: ingest and release durable logical key-plus-value bytes exceed the configured LSM memtable; quick and paranoid profiles are explicitly bounded and are not production-scale ingest evidence
protocol.os_page_cache: enabled and not cleared between runs; every measurement uses a fresh directory

engine_settings.version: 0.6.0 (path source measured at report git commit)
engine_settings.storage_model: write-ahead log; one record per mutation

acknowledgement_modes.acknowledgement: StorageConfig/WalConfig::durable; committed v5 record through a physically reserved shared WAL mapping, with ordered file-write fallback, and sync_on_write=false
acknowledgement_modes.conservative_difference: TurboKV reserves active-WAL capacity in bounded chunks; unsupported allocation APIs retain the ordered-write path

acknowledgement_modes.acknowledgement: StorageConfig/WalConfig::paranoid; Rust File::sync_all; group size 1 and zero collection delay

engine_settings.settlement: foreground flush then two coordinated manual compaction drains
engine_settings.automatic_flush_workers: one async task installed; polling interval raised to 3600 seconds
engine_settings.automatic_compaction_workers: one async task installed; polling interval raised to 3600 seconds
engine_settings.differences: async API; bounded runs use explicit foreground flush/compaction before deferred polling

engine_settings.storage_model: write-ahead journal; manual persistence enabled on keyspace and partition

acknowledgement_modes.acknowledgement: partition insert then Keyspace::persist(PersistMode::Buffer), flushing the journal BufWriter to OS buffers without fsync
acknowledgement_modes.conservative_difference: persistence call is keyspace-wide; the benchmark has one partition and one caller

acknowledgement_modes.acknowledgement: partition insert then Keyspace::persist(PersistMode::SyncAll), which calls File::sync_all on the journal
acknowledgement_modes.conservative_difference: full-sync call is keyspace-wide; the benchmark has one partition and one caller

engine_settings.settlement: SyncAll, rotate_memtable_and_wait, then two major_compact calls
engine_settings.automatic_compaction_workers: zero; all compaction is explicit and foreground
engine_settings.differences: manual compaction has no public byte counters in the pinned version

engine_settings.storage_model: copy-on-write B-tree; one transaction per mutation

acknowledgement_modes.acknowledgement: one write transaction committed with redb Durability::Eventual
acknowledgement_modes.conservative_difference: redb has no exact buffer-only durability level; Eventual queues persistence and is a conservative, potentially stronger boundary than TurboKV durable mode

acknowledgement_modes.acknowledgement: one write transaction committed with redb Durability::Immediate, followed by Rust File::sync_all on the database file
acknowledgement_modes.conservative_difference: redb commits a complete copy-on-write transaction rather than a WAL-only mutation; the extra full-file barrier preserves the benchmark's macOS power-loss boundary

engine_settings.settlement: empty Immediate transaction, then two Database::compact calls, each followed by Rust File::sync_all
engine_settings.automatic_flush_workers: none; commits write copy-on-write pages directly
engine_settings.automatic_compaction_workers: none; compaction is explicit and foreground
engine_settings.differences: pure-Rust copy-on-write B-tree with single-writer transactions, not an LSM; compression and memtables are not applicable, and the configurable cache is disabled

counter_availability.disk_bytes: recursive exact file length at measurement boundary
counter_availability.amplification: WAL + flush output + compaction output divided by timed logical mutation bytes

counter_availability.disk_bytes: recursive exact file length at measurement boundary
counter_availability.wal_bytes: unavailable in fjall 2.11.2 public API; JSON null
counter_availability.flush_bytes: unavailable in fjall 2.11.2 public API; JSON null
counter_availability.compaction_bytes: unavailable in fjall 2.11.2 public API; JSON null
counter_availability.amplification: unavailable because component byte counters are unavailable; JSON null

counter_availability.disk_bytes: recursive exact file length at measurement boundary
counter_availability.wal_bytes: unavailable in redb 2.6.3 public API; JSON null
counter_availability.flush_bytes: unavailable because redb writes copy-on-write pages at commit; JSON null
counter_availability.compaction_bytes: unavailable in redb 2.6.3 public API; JSON null
counter_availability.amplification: unavailable because component byte counters are unavailable; JSON null

environment.source_manifest_hash_algorithm: Git blob object ID using this repository's SHA-1 object format
environment.source_manifest_scope: bytewise path-sorted `mode type blob_oid<TAB>path` records from `git ls-tree -r --full-tree HEAD`, excluding only paths under benchmarks/results/, joined with LF and terminated by LF
environment.power_policy: operator-controlled; harness does not change macOS power settings
environment.thermal_policy: operator-controlled; harness does not read or change fan/thermal policy
environment.background_load: release protocol requires an otherwise idle host; not programmatically enforced
